title: prunus amygdalus
intro: Prunus amygdalus, commonly known as bitter almond, is a plant species in the rose family (Rosaceae) that is native to the Middle East and the Mediterranean region. The health benefits of Prunus amygdalus include its potential to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of the plant include its use as a carminative to relieve flatulence and indigestion, as well as its application in traditional medicine to treat various ailments such as fever and cough. The bioactive constituents of Prunus amygdalus include amygdalin, a cyanogenic glycoside that releases hydrogen cyanide, as well as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
